about_body_1.en: I'm a Robotics Engineering student. I design the mechanical system and write the software that runs it — CAD and fabrication at one end, embedded firmware and ROS nodes at the other, and the control loop in between.
about_body_1.zh: 我是机器人工程专业的学生。机械结构和驱动它的软件都由我做——一端是 CAD 与加工，另一端是嵌入式固件与 ROS 节点，中间是控制环路。

about_body_2.en: Outside of engineering, I enjoy photography and running

projects_subheading.en: Autonomy, control, and the hardware underneath — plus a few things built for their own sake. Most rows link to the repository.
projects_subheading.zh: 自主导航、运动控制及其底层硬件，以及一些纯粹出于兴趣的项目。点击查看详情或跳转代码仓库。

proj_humanoid_title.zh: 模仿学习双臂包裹处理

proj_humanoid_desc.en: A dual-arm humanoid that picks up a parcel, determines whether its shipping label faces upward, and flips the parcel when it does not. The behaviour is learned by imitation from 200 VR teleoperation demonstrations rather than programmed. My contribution is the deployment stack between the trained model and the robot: an inverse-kinematics solver that converts the model's requested hand poses into joint motion, and a physics simulation that validates every trajectory before the arms execute it.
proj_humanoid_desc.zh: 双臂人形机器人抓取包裹、判断快递单是否朝上，并在不朝上时将其翻转。该动作并非编程写定，而是由 200 组 VR 遥操作示教通过模仿学习得到。我负责模型与真机之间的部署链路：将模型输出的手部位姿解算为关节运动的逆运动学求解器，以及在真机执行前校验每一段轨迹的物理仿真。

proj_engineer_arm_title.zh: RoboMaster 工程机器人机械臂

proj_engineer_arm_desc.en: A six-joint manipulator for the RoboMaster Engineer robot of NUS Calibur, designed by me: a carbon-fibre and aluminium structure holding a 500 g payload at full extension on motor torque alone, with no springs or counterweights. The first version oscillated because each joint was supported on one side only, so a lateral load at the gripper bent its mounting plate and the deflection was amplified along the arm. The second version supports the shoulder on both sides, and took First Prize at RMUL 2026.
proj_engineer_arm_desc.zh: 为 NUS Calibur 战队 RoboMaster 工程机器人设计的六关节机械臂：碳纤维与铝结构，在无弹簧、无配重的条件下仅靠电机扭矩于完全伸展时托住 500 g 负载。第一版存在振动，原因是各关节仅单侧支撑，夹爪处的侧向载荷会使安装板弯曲，形变沿臂长被放大。第二版改为肩关节双侧支撑，并在 RMUL 2026 获一等奖。

proj_slam_title.zh: 精准对接货物运送机器人

proj_slam_desc.en: An autonomous TurtleBot3 that explores an unmapped maze, detects printed ArUco markers on its walls, docks square to one, and launches ping-pong balls into a receptacle without an operator. My contribution is the complete mechanical design — a nine-ball gravity-fed magazine and a cam-and-spring launcher — and the docking controller, which estimates the marker's pose from the camera image and aligns the robot to the marker's normal.
proj_slam_desc.zh: 自主运行的 TurtleBot3：在未知迷宫中自主探索，识别墙面上的 ArUco 标记，正对标记停靠，并将乒乓球射入接收装置，全程无需操作手。我负责全部机械设计——九发重力供弹弹仓与凸轮弹片发射机构——以及停靠控制器：由相机图像估计标记位姿，并使车身对正标记法线。

proj_pcb_desc.en: Three KiCad boards that transfer power and control signals across the continuously rotating turret joint of a RoboMaster sentry through a slip ring, so the turret can rotate without limit and without twisting its cable harness. Two CAN buses and three power rails cross the interface, each rail paralleled over several slip-ring channels in poured copper so that no single channel carries the full current.
proj_pcb_desc.zh: 三块 KiCad 电路板，经滑环在 RoboMaster 哨兵持续旋转的云台关节两侧传递电源与控制信号，使云台可无限位旋转而不绞线。跨接口传输两路 CAN 总线与三路电源，每路电源以敷铜并联分摊到多个滑环通道，避免单一通道承担全部电流。

proj_aimbot_title.zh: 便携式自瞄测试移动靶

proj_aimbot_desc.en: Test equipment for auto-aim development: a rig that drives an armour plate at a commanded speed and records the impact position of each projectile, so that testing no longer occupies a second robot and a driver, and sessions run weeks apart remain comparable. Impact position is located by timing the arrival of the shock at piezo sensors around the plate. It disassembles into a single checked bag for travel to competitions. A two-person project; the mechanical design is mine.
proj_aimbot_desc.zh: 为自瞄开发提供的测试设备：靶架以设定速度驱动装甲板运动，并记录每发弹丸的落点，使测试不再占用第二台机器人和一名操作手，相隔数周的多次测试亦可横向比较。落点由板周压电传感器接收冲击的时间差定位。整机可拆装收入一只托运行李箱，随队参赛。两人项目，我负责全部机械设计。

proj_arm_title.zh: YBot 桌面级六自由度机械臂

proj_arm_desc.en: A desktop six-joint robot arm designed and built from scratch for approximately S$610 in parts: a 3D-printed PETG structure, closed-loop NEMA stepper motors driving 50:1 harmonic-drive reducers, and a magnetic encoder on every output shaft for absolute joint feedback. The mechanical build is complete; the ROS 2 motion-planning software on top of it is not.
proj_arm_desc.zh: 从零设计并制作的桌面级六关节机械臂，整机物料约 610 新元：PETG 3D 打印结构，闭环 NEMA 步进电机经 50:1 谐波减速器驱动，每个输出轴均配磁编码器提供绝对关节反馈。机械部分已完成，其上的 ROS 2 运动规划软件尚未完成。

proj_lightpanel_desc.en: Modular triangular wall lighting, screwed together in arbitrary arrangements: 3D-printed shells with laser-cut acrylic diffusers retained on an internal lip by friction alone. The mating tolerances required several CAD iterations. The electrical side was the weak point — soldering was beyond me at the time, so the panels were linked with commercial connectors, which worked loose and caused intermittent flashing.
proj_lightpanel_desc.zh: 模块化三角形墙面灯板，可用螺丝任意拼接：外壳 3D 打印，激光切割的亚克力扩散板仅靠内侧凸缘的摩擦固定。配合公差经过数轮 CAD 迭代。电气部分是短板——当时尚不会焊接，灯板之间以外购连接件相连，接触松脱导致灯板间歇闪烁。

proj_lightpanel_detail.en:
I began this project first in 2023, as I wanted some aesthetic lighting in my room and the ones sold on the market are too expensive. So I decided I would try to make my own.
The design of the lights is modular, allowing two units to be attached together using screws. Back then, I wasn’t very experienced with CAD, and I ran into a lot of issues with tolerances since the pieces needed to fit perfectly into each other. This forced me to go through several iterations before I was satisfied with the result.
The casing was 3D printed, and the inner light diffuser piece was laser cut from acrylic. The diffuser sits on a small lip and stays in place through friction with the walls of the light. I attached a light strip along the side walls of the panels and connected them using special wires. At the time, I had zero experience with electronics and didn’t know how to solder, so I bought a connection cable from Amazon to link the modular pieces together. That turned out to be a huge pain—it caused constant connection issues and even made several panels flash rapidly because of the poor connectivity.
proj_lightpanel_detail.zh:
这个项目最早是 2023 年开始的，当时我想在房间里弄点有氛围感的灯，但市面上卖的都太贵了，所以我就想，干脆自己做一个。
灯的设计是模块化的，两块之间可以用螺丝拼接起来。那时候我 CAD 还不太熟，在公差上踩了很多坑——零件之间要严丝合缝地扣在一起，我来来回回改了好几版，才算满意。
外壳是 3D 打印的，里面的扩散板是亚克力激光切割的。扩散板搁在一圈小凸缘上，靠与灯壁之间的摩擦固定住。我沿着灯板的侧壁贴了灯带，再用专门的线把它们连起来。当时我对电子一窍不通，也不会焊接，就在亚马逊上买了连接线来接这些模块件。结果这东西特别折腾——接触一直有问题，甚至因为接触不良，让好几块灯板疯狂闪烁。

proj_speaker_desc.en: A two-driver Bluetooth speaker built from a published tutorial, and my first electronics project: the printed enclosure, the wiring and every solder joint in it are my own work, and it is where I learned to solder. Diagnosing audible background noise in the output identified the DC-DC voltage converter as its source, coupling switching noise directly into the audio path.
proj_speaker_desc.zh: 依照公开教程制作的双单元蓝牙音箱，也是我的第一个电子项目：外壳打印、走线与其中每一个焊点均由本人完成，焊接技能亦始于此。排查输出中的可闻底噪后定位到 DC-DC 电压转换电路，其开关噪声直接耦合进了音频回路。

proj_speaker_detail.en:
I followed an online tutorial for this project because I thought it was really cool how 3D printing was being used. It was my first time using 3D-printed parts as molds to pour other materials, and it got me excited to try it out myself. I ended up building a custom Bluetooth speaker from scratch, which was also my first big hands-on project with soldering, wiring, and electronics.
Through the process, I learned a lot about how speakers actually work—like how a voltage converter can cause electronic noise that affects sound quality. I also picked up a ton of practical skills in soldering, wire management, and troubleshooting (most of which I learned from failed attempts).
The end result was a compact Bluetooth speaker that worked and sounded great, and the whole experience gave me confidence with electronics while sparking my interest in audio engineering.
proj_speaker_detail.zh:
这个项目我是照着网上的教程做的，因为我觉得 3D 打印被这样用实在太酷了。那也是我第一次接触拿 3D 打印件当模具、往里浇注其他材料，看完就特别想自己也试一试。最后我从零做出了一台自制蓝牙音箱，这同时也是我第一个真正动手的大项目，涉及焊接、走线和电子。
做的过程中，我学到了很多音箱实际是怎么工作的——比如电压转换电路会产生电噪声，影响音质。我也积累了一堆实打实的技能，像焊接、理线和排查问题（其中大部分都是从失败里学来的）。
最后的成品是一台小巧的蓝牙音箱，能用，声音也很好；整个过程让我对电子有了信心，也让我对音频工程产生了兴趣。

bloomcraft_desc.en: A web application that generates costed floral arrangements from a natural-language brief. An LLM converts the brief — occasion, recipient, style and budget — into structured JSON selected from a priced flower catalogue, so the quoted total is computed rather than estimated, and a Stable Diffusion 2.1 model fine-tuned on bouquet imagery renders the result. Each flower carries its meaning in the recipient's region, which differs across cultures.
bloomcraft_desc.zh: 从自然语言需求生成带报价花束方案的网页应用。LLM 将需求——场合、赠予对象、风格与预算——转换为结构化 JSON，并从带价目的花材库中选配，使总价来自计算而非估测；再由针对花束图像微调的 Stable Diffusion 2.1 模型渲染成品。每种花材均附有其在收花地区的寓意，同一花材在不同文化中含义可能相反。

proj_portfolio_desc.en: A minimal bilingual portfolio in React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, deployed to Vercel behind a custom domain.
proj_portfolio_desc.zh: 使用 React、Vite 与 Tailwind CSS 构建的极简双语作品集，部署至 Vercel 并配置自定义域名。

contact_subheading.en: I'm open to internships, research collaborations, and interesting side projects.
contact_subheading.zh: 随时欢迎实习、科研以及有趣项目
